translations.text: The word of the Lord that came to Zephaniah son of Cushi, son of Gedaliah, son of Amariah, son of Hezekiah, in the days of Josiah son of Amon, king of Judah.
Everything will utterly disappear from the face of the earth, says the Lord.
Humans and animals will perish; the birds of heaven and the fish of the sea will perish, and the ungodly will grow weak. I will remove the lawless from the face of the earth, says the Lord.
I will stretch out my hand against Judah and against all the inhabitants of Jerusalem. I will remove from that place the name of Baal and the name of the pagan priests, together with the priests,
those who bow down on the rooftops to the heavenly hosts, and those who swear in the Lord’s name to their king,
and those who turned away from the Lord, those who did not seek the Lord, and those who were not on the Lord’s side.
Be afraid before the Lord God, for the day of the Lord is near. The Lord has prepared his sacrifice and invited his guests.
On the day of the Lord’s sacrifice, I will exact vengeance on the rulers, on the royal household, and on everyone dressed in foreign clothing.
On that day I will openly exact vengeance on all those before the thresholds who fill the house of the Lord their God with ungodliness and deceit.
On that day, says the Lord, there will be the sound of a cry from the Gate of the Wounded, a lament from the second gate, and a great crashing from the hills.
Lament, inhabitants of the devastated place, for all this people has become like the Canaanites. All who were proud of their silver have been destroyed.
On that day I will search Jerusalem with a lamp and exact vengeance on the men who despised their safeguards, who said in their hearts, ‘The Lord does neither good nor evil.’
Their wealth will become plunder, and their houses will be destroyed. They will build houses but will not live in them; they will plant vineyards but will not drink their wine.
For the great day of the Lord is near, near and coming very quickly. The sound of the day of the Lord is harsh and bitter, powerfully arrayed.
That day is a day of wrath, a day of distress and danger, a day of misery and destruction, a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and thick mist.
A day of trumpet blasts and shouting against fortified cities and against high corner towers.

I will bring distress upon people, and they will walk like the blind, because they sinned against the Lord and invoked his name over worthless things that could do nothing to help them. He will pour out their blood like dust and their flesh like dung.

Their silver and gold will not be able to save them on the day of the Lord’s wrath. The whole earth will be consumed by the fire of his jealousy, for he will bring an end and anguish upon all the inhabitants of the earth.
Gather yourselves and seek, you undisciplined nations,
before you become like a passing flower, before the day of the Lord’s wrath and fury comes.
Seek the Lord, all you humble people of the earth. Do justice, seek righteousness, and give them an answer, so that you may be hidden on the day of the Lord’s anger.
For Gaza will be plundered, and Ashkelon will be destroyed. Ashdod will be overthrown at noon, and Ekron will be uprooted.
Woe to you who live in the coastal regions, inhabitants of Crete! The word of the Lord is against you, Canaan, land of the Philistines, and I will destroy you from your dwelling place.
Crete will become pasture for flocks and pens for sheep.

The coastal territory will belong to the remnant of the house of Judah. They will graze there and lodge for the night in the houses of Ashkelon, away from the presence of the sons of Judah, for the Lord their God has come to visit them and has brought them back from captivity.
I have heard the insults of Moab and the taunts of the children of Ammon, with which they insulted my people and boasted against my borders.

Therefore, as I live, says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, Moab will become like Sodom, and the sons of Ammon like Gomorrah, and Damascus will be abandoned like a heap on a threshing floor and destroyed forever. The remnant of my people will plunder them, and the remnant of my nation will possess them.
This will be their repayment for their pride, because they insulted and spoke arrogantly against the Lord Almighty.
The Lord will appear against them and destroy all the gods of the nations. All the islands of the nations will bow down to him, each from its own place.
You Ethiopians too are slain by my sword.
I will stretch out my hand against the north and destroy Assyria, and I will make Nineveh a desolation, waterless like a desert.

Flocks and all the wild beasts of the earth will graze within her. Chameleons and hedgehogs will dwell in her buildings; wild beasts will cry out in her cellars, and ravens at her gates, for her lofty structure is like a cedar.

This is the vengeful city that dwelt securely, saying in her heart, “I am, and there will be no one else after me.” How she has become a desolation, a pasture for wild beasts! Everyone who passes through her will hiss and shake his head.
O renowned, redeemed city, the dove!
She did not listen to the voice or accept correction. She did not trust in the Lord or draw near to her God.
Her rulers will roar like lions, and her judges are like the wolves of Arabia, which leave nothing for the morning.
Her prophets are demon-possessed and contemptuous. Her priests defile the holy things and act wickedly against the law.

But the Lord is righteous within her and will do no injustice. Early each morning he will bring my judgments to light and will not hide them, and he will not acknowledge injustice when exacting payment.

And not utterly [?] injustice; he will overthrow the proud with destruction. Their corners have been destroyed. I will lay waste their roads so that no one will travel along them anymore. Their cities will disappear for lack of inhabitants.

I said, “Fear me and accept correction, and you will not be destroyed from her presence, according to all the vengeance I take upon her.” Prepare to rise early in the morning; all her efforts have been ruined.

Therefore wait for me, says the Lord, for the day when I rise up as a witness. For my judgment is upon the nations, to seize kings and pour out upon them my anger, all my furious wrath; for the whole earth will be consumed by the fire of my jealousy.
For then I will change the language of the peoples among their nations, so that they may all call upon the name of the Lord and serve him under one yoke.
From the river of the Ethiopians I will receive them among the scattered; they will bring me offerings.

On that day you will not be ashamed of all your deeds by which you acted wickedly against me, for then I will remove from you the evil of your arrogance, and you will no longer boast upon my holy mountain.
I will leave you a meek and humble people, and they will fear the name of the Lord.
The remnant of Israel will do no injustice and speak no falsehood, and no deceitful tongue will be found in their mouths. For they will graze and lie down, and there will be no one to terrify them.
Rejoice greatly, daughter of Zion, and proclaim, Jerusalem! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, daughter of Jerusalem!
For the Lord has removed the injustices from around you; the Lord has delivered you from the hands of your enemies. The King of Israel, the Lord, is within you, and you will no longer see evil.
At that time the Lord will say to Jerusalem, “Take courage, Zion! Do not let your hands grow weak.”
The Lord God is within you, the mighty one, and he will save you. He will bring joy upon you and renew you with his love, and he will rejoice over you with gladness, as on a feast day.
And I will gather your shattered ones. Woe to anyone who reproaches her!
Look, I will act for you at that time. I will save the oppressed and receive the outcast, and I will make them a source of praise and renown throughout the earth.

And they will be ashamed at that time, when I do you good, and at the time when I receive you. For I will give you renown and praise among all the nations of the earth, when I restore your captives before your eyes, says the Lord.
